title: No Limits
narrativeText: Fire. Barbwire. Thumbtacks. A steel chair that has long since been bent out of shape. Sabu has no concept of limits, no concept of self-preservation, no concept of anything except ending this match in the most spectacular manner possible.

choices.label: Go Through Everything
choices.text: Homicidal. Suicidal. Genocidal. Through fire if necessary.
